llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper for the gws CLI to manage Google Tasks and its declared requirements and actions are coherent with that purpose, but it delegates auth/config to an external shared SKILL that you should inspect before use.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (Google Tasks) match the runtime instructions, which call the 'gws' CLI to list, get, insert, update, delete, etc. tasklists and tasks. Requiring the 'gws' binary is expected for this functionality and there are no unrelated binaries or env vars declared.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md stays within the Tasks API surface and only instructs running 'gws tasks' and 'gws schema'. However it has a prerequisite to read '../gws-shared/SKILL.md' for auth, global flags, and security rules — that external file is not included here, so the true runtime auth/config behavior is delegated and not visible in this skill. Inspect that shared SKILL before enabling this skill.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is instruction-only with no install spec and no code files. Nothing will be written to disk by the skill itself; risk comes from the external 'gws' binary which must already exist and be trusted.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No env vars or credentials are declared in this package, which is consistent because auth is delegated to a shared SKILL. That delegation is reasonable for a CLI wrapper but you should verify what credentials (OAuth tokens, API keys, or files) the shared SKILL requires or creates before granting access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not marked always:true and does not request system-wide config paths. It does not autonomously gain elevated persistence beyond normal skill invocation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a lightweight, coherent wrapper around an existing 'gws' CLI and appears legitimate for managing Google Tasks. Before installing: (1) confirm the 'gws' binary on your system is the official, trusted Google Workspace CLI and review its permissions; (2) locate and read the referenced '../gws-shared/SKILL.md' (or run the suggested 'gws generate-skills') to see exactly how authentication and global flags are handled and what credentials will be used or stored; (3) if the shared SKILL requests OAuth tokens, keys, or file paths, ensure you are comfortable with how those credentials are stored and used. If you cannot inspect the shared SKILL or verify the 'gws' binary origin, treat this as higher risk.
